cohort: 8,988 women with singleton gestation, term live birth, vertex presentation, no previous cesarean section, vaginal delivery, and neonatal Apgar score at 5 minutes at 7 or higher
finding: Once effective uterine contractions are achieved with oxytocin augmentation and the cervix is dilated more than 5 cm, cervical dilation to the next centimeter occurs within 2 hours in 95% of both nulliparous and multiparous women.
